title: chaenorhinum origanifolium subsp. capitatum
intro: Chaenorhinum origanifolium subsp. capitatum, commonly known as the Edible or Mountain Snorkel, is a plant species within the Scrophulariaceae family. It is known for its use in traditional medicine, where it provides relief from various health issues. The plant is said to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and aiding in digestion, while its therapeutic actions include antispasmodic and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Chaenorhinum origanifolium subsp. capitatum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
